clauses.code: int min_span(int *pos, int n, int k) { int ans = n; for(int i = 1; i <= n - k + 1; i++) { int span = check_range(pos, i, k); if(span < ans) ans = span; } return ans; }

clauses.code: int compute_span(int map[], int val, int k) { int lo = map[val], hi = map[val]; for(int j = val; j < val + k; j++) { if(map[j] < lo) lo = map[j]; if(map[j] > hi) hi = map[j]; } return hi - lo; }
